answer: The raven is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wander. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
